title: A patrolling Shopkeeper's walk lasts one step
description: A Shopkeeper on patrol in open ground sets off walking, but his walk's check for a wall ahead sends him back to patrolling on the very next step. He coasts a few pixels to a stop, waits, and shuffles again, every second or so.
